answer: We design a Sybil-resistant mechanism using zero-knowledge verifiable delay and staking collateral, demanding each network atlas identity commit reserves to initialize a cipher state. This capital barrier forces the expected payoff of identity multiplication to be strictly negative, since an adversarial signal triggering subgame-perfect slashing penalties instantly liquidates malicious collateral. Thus, these cryptoeconomic security primitives establish a robust Nash equilibrium, ensuring unilateral Sybil generation yields suboptimal utility, neutralizing all coordinated attacks.
